conclusions: The original restricted lower-root chart becomes block lower unitriangular after the block reversing permutation. Internal lower roots inside a reversing block are omitted. Block Gaussian recovery divides only by the nonzero full block determinants, never by internal leading minors.

The five displayed radical inverse formulas recover both X variables, both skew-Hermitian K variables and gamma. Together with fixed nonzero block determinants they give properness of the actual quotient-coordinate parametrization on compact matrix sets, locally uniformly in all nonzero head parameters.
The full-lower-group size-two negative control correctly exhibits an unbounded stabilizer fibre. The proof uses the original restricted chart rather than integrating this incorrect larger domain.

The exact source Gram identity multiplies the smaller Gram polynomial by abs(det Z)^2. The head determinant is fixed on its integration chart, so the original positive cutoff and all derivative cutoffs survive with epsilon/abs(det Z_h)^2.
The original signed-letter denominators are nonzero on the head chart and the operators do not enlarge support. This proves SliceCpt even for finite words outside the admissible class.

The singleton shear A=V L0^{-1} w_sigma^{-1}, B=U0^{-1} B0 has real absolute Jacobian one and preserves the exact corner characters. Root-height triangularity, central translations and unitary compact conjugations give the recursively prescribed unipotent Haar measure, with probability compact measures and no residual scalar.

The last-border Capelli identity uses the actual left scalar c*(Z^{-1})_{bj}. Its cofactor contraction is the ordinary adjugate identity with first j-1 rows, valid for arbitrary invertible Z. Both the plus and conjugate-minus spectral shifts match the source, including j=0 and the prescribed zero second component.

Coefficient minors are frozen before the enveloping-algebra expression is formed. On this chart they depend on Z alone; the restricted size-j operator differentiates only Z and commutes with the new c operators. Exterior covariance preserves the required character laws after every preceding letter.

The original bT recursion inserts an undressed site matrix at each fresh tensor position in the same head-after-tail order as uwG. Rational R-matrix dressing belongs to a different operator and is not introduced. Equality on the punctured plane implies equality of all needed derivatives, so the source arbitrary V1 representative quantifier is retained.

The radial gauge abs(c)^(2*(r-j)+k) conjugates both letter matrices to the established one-coordinate matrices. Multiplying its square by abs(c)^(-2) gives exactly levW at j+1 below the terminal level.
The recursive one-pair integration formula and the fixed normalized tower retain the positive Jacquet factor. No ratio of unrelated level constants is assumed.

The established finite-word Schwartz marginal theorem applies to the actual compact sliced coefficient class. Smooth compact-family dependence identifies its density at every nonzero c, not merely almost everywhere. Sesquilinearity allows two different heads using a common positive cutoff.
